sources.title: LM111/umi-arena-pi05-yubi-umi · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository is a policy submitted to the UMI Arena policy competition (Track 1). It is an openpi pi0.5 model, fully fine-tuned from pi05_base on the released YUBI UMI Arena dataset (airoa-org/yubi-corl2026-umi-arena). The training run is the openpi config pi05_yubi_umi at step 59999.
